content_units.proposition: Connect entry, reservation, cancellation, charges, and review, ultimately analyzing G's entire sequence; Monday confirmation for Wednesday 10:00—12:00.

locations.excerpt: Part one begins with the whole problem: How does the Study Society connect entry, reservations, cancellation, fees, and review into one system? G later fails to cancel, the premises close on Wednesday, and G finally requests a refund of reservation points.

terms.decision: Means only that registered members may enter the public reading area under L1; do not rewrite it as a seat guarantee.
Successful confirmation issued by the reservation system; clicking to apply, queuing, and acknowledgment are not equivalent.
The same managing role in the source: L1 says manager and L3 says administrator; do not presume two distinct institutions.
A person with successful confirmation for a specific period; state whether the reservation relationship remains valid in the analysis.
The reserving person requires the manager to provide a standard seat during the confirmed period; this does not automatically become another member's duty to yield.
Record separately, without substitution; cancellation under L2 takes effect on receipt of notice by the system.
L2's wording 'before 18:00' includes exactly 18:00 under this exercise's supplementary provision; do not generalize to real law.
An act terminating a relationship by satisfying L2's deadline and receipt conditions; it does not cancel membership.
An alternative route after the deadline requiring both parties' consent; merely sending a request is insufficient.
Suspension of the seating duty during a safety closure under L3; it neither automatically terminates the reservation nor extends its end time.
Arrival of the original confirmed end time; lateness does not extend it.
The overlap between safety closure and a valid reservation, not the reserving person's actual time away from a seat.
L4 charges 10 points per hour and 5 per half-hour; do not invent rules for other increments.
Review of rule application and timing facts under L5; procedural timeliness and substantive validity of the claim are separate.
Count from the day after awareness, with receipt before the end of day seven; this calculation is limited to the exercise.
The same member across all three chapters; later receipt at 17:59 is a hypothetical variant and does not replace the main fact of receipt at 18:02.
